info.name: BookFlow — Planned business examples (not smoke tests)
info.description: Contract examples only. These endpoints are not implemented yet and return 404 in the foundation. Never use this collection as evidence of passed business tests. Choose individual requests only after the responsible module is implemented. Populate tokens and IDs locally; never commit credentials.

request.description: Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Reject unknown properties including role/status. Trim fullName and email; lowercase email. Store only an Argon2id password hash. Registration does not issue a session.

item.name: [PLANNED] Create an access and refresh session

request.description: Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Return a short-lived HS256 JWT (sub, iss, aud, iat, exp), opaque rotated refresh token in bookflow_refresh, and a CSRF token. bookflow_refresh uses Path=/api/v1/auth and HttpOnly; bookflow_csrf uses Path=/ and is JavaScript-readable so page reload can restore the session. Both use SameSite=Strict and Secure on HTTPS. The CSRF token must be signed and bound to the refresh session. Generic 401 for all invalid credentials. No-store.

Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Require trusted Origin and X-CSRF-Token equal to the signed, session-bound bookflow_csrf cookie; validate the signature and refresh-session binding. Frontend can read this cookie at Path=/ after a page reload. Rotate refresh token atomically, storing only a hash. Detect reuse and revoke the family. Return replacement cookies using their original paths. Frontend serializes refresh requests; never retry indefinitely.

Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Require trusted Origin and matching CSRF header/cookie; revoke the family and clear bookflow_refresh with Path=/api/v1/auth and bookflow_csrf with Path=/. An already revoked session remains logged out. Access JWT can remain valid until expiry.

Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Body only bookId; borrower comes from verified principal. Enforce 3 active loans, no overdue loan, and no duplicate open loan for the same book. Due date is borrowedAt + 14*24 hours. Lock user → book → copy; insert loan and audit in one transaction. 409 codes include BOOK_UNAVAILABLE, LOAN_LIMIT_REACHED, OVERDUE_LOANS, ALREADY_BORROWED. Do not automatically retry ambiguous POST outcomes.

item.name: [PLANNED] Create or read the unique return confirmation

request.description: Not implemented by the foundation. Execute only after its owning module is merged. Accept exactly {}. Server determines returnedAt/returnedBy on the first call. Lock copy then loan and update loan+audit in one transaction. Repeated PUT returns the original confirmation without a second audit or timestamp change.

Counts at asOf: activeBooks excludes archived books; serviceableCopies excludes RETIRED copies; activeLoans includes all unreturned loans; overdueLoans are unreturned loans with dueAt < asOf. No borrower personal data.
